title: Subtraction Picnic
shareTitle: Subtraction Picnic 🐿️ — Share, Take Away, and Count
description: Share watercolor picnic snacks with Squirrel, Fox, and Bear, watch a subtraction story happen, and count how many are left within six.
learningGoals: Model subtraction as physically taking away from a visible group
Connect a take-away story to a completed subtraction equation
Count and reason about the quantity left within 6
interactionModel: Choose one of three picture-book picnic modes. Tap a snack or drag it to a forest friend, then tap the numeral that matches what remains; Picnic Party lets children choose a friend and freely change the equation.
feedbackModel: Every shared snack disappears from the blanket and updates the live equation. Recorded teacher narration, a gentle count-again retry, pulsing remaining food, a happy friend, and a large solved tableau model the result without scores, timers, or punishment.

modes.title: Apple Take-Away
modes.skill: connecting take-away actions to subtraction equations

modes.title: Picnic Party
modes.skill: free-play exploration of how subtraction changes the amount left

summary: Share snacks with watercolor forest friends, watch subtraction happen, and count what is left within 6.
